title: Transitive symmetry of majority
statement: For every natural number $n$, the majority function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ is transitive symmetric: for any two coordinates $i,i'\\in\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$, there is a permutation $\\pi$ of the coordinates with $\\pi(i)=i'$ such that applying $\\pi$ to the input leaves the majority value unchanged for every input.
